candidates.title: 자료형마다 다섯 가지를 본다
aliases: 선언과 입력 읽기 추가 삭제 수정
candidates.concept_granularity: single frame the course puts every data type through - how it is declared and filled, read, added to, deleted from and changed - applied in turn to numbers, strings, lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets and booleans

candidates.title: 인덱스와 잘라내기
candidates.concept_granularity: single way of reaching into a string by position, counted from the front or from the back with negative numbers, and of taking a range that runs from the first index up to but not including the second - which is also the only way to change a string, since its characters cannot be assigned to and a new string has to be built from the pieces

candidates.title: Object 자료형
candidates.concept_granularity: single way of storing values under names rather than in an order, where only the value is really the data and the key is the name it is reached by

candidates.title: 파이썬 리스트
candidates.concept_granularity: single way of holding several related values under one name, written in square brackets separated by commas, reached by index, and holding values of different types at once - with the constructor preferred over the empty brackets when declaring an empty one

candidates.title: 중첩 리스트
candidates.concept_granularity: single arrangement of a list holding lists, indexed one level at a time and sliced the same way, which is how a two-dimensional table is represented without a separate type for it

candidates.title: 리스트에서 지우는 세 가지 방법
candidates.concept_granularity: single choice among three removals differing in what they take and what they leave - one names the position, one names the value and removes only its first occurrence, and one takes the last element out and returns it

candidates.title: 리스트에 넣는 두 가지 방법
candidates.concept_granularity: single pair of insertions - one puts a single element at the end, the other puts one at a named position

candidates.title: 리스트 함수들
candidates.concept_granularity: single set of methods over a list - sorting it, turning it back to front without sorting, finding a value's position, counting occurrences, and extending it by another list, which comes to the same thing as adding the two - where the position method raises an error on a missing value while the string one returns minus one

candidates.title: 파이썬 튜플
candidates.concept_granularity: single structure differing from the list in one respect that decides everything else - its contents cannot be changed after it is made, so it can be declared and read and nothing more, which is exactly why it is reached for where a value must not be altered

candidates.title: 괄호 없는 튜플
candidates.concept_granularity: single idiom that follows from the parentheses being optional - two names on each side of the assignment are two tuples, so a swap needs no temporary variable, and a function returning two values is returning one tuple

candidates.title: 딕셔너리
candidates.concept_granularity: single structure of key and value pairs, also called an associative array or a hash, which unlike the ordered structures is not walked through to find something - the key alone reaches the value - and which is therefore indexed by key rather than by position

candidates.title: 딕셔너리 키의 제약
aliases: 변하는 값은 키가 될 수 없다
candidates.concept_granularity: single pair of restrictions following from the key being what finds the value - a repeated key keeps only one of its values, and a key must be something that cannot change, which admits the immutable sequence type and excludes the mutable one

candidates.title: 딕셔너리 함수들
candidates.concept_granularity: single set of methods returning views rather than lists - the keys, the values, and the pairs as tuples, which are cheaper than building a list and are what a loop iterates over - alongside clearing, membership testing, and the safe read that answers with nothing, or with a chosen default, where a direct read would raise

candidates.title: 파이썬 집합
candidates.concept_granularity: single structure defined by two absences - no duplicates and no order - which is why it cannot be indexed and why the empty one must be made with the constructor, the braces belonging to the dictionary

candidates.title: 집합 연산
candidates.concept_granularity: single set of four operations written either as an operator or as a method - what is in both, what is in either, what is in the first only, and what is in either but not both

candidates.title: 집합을 중복 제거 필터로
candidates.concept_granularity: single use the no-duplicates property is most often put to - a list with repeats is converted to a set and back, which removes them without writing any comparison

candidates.title: 불 자료형과 참 거짓 판정
candidates.concept_granularity: single pair of truth values, together with the rule that any other value can stand in for one - a string, list, tuple, dictionary or set counts as false when empty and true otherwise, zero is false, and the single object of the null type is false

candidates.title: 변수는 객체의 주소를 가리킨다
candidates.concept_granularity: single fact about assignment that explains a whole class of surprises - everything is an object and a variable holds where that object is, not the object, so assigning one variable to another makes both point at the same thing and a change through one is visible through the other

candidates.title: 값만 복사하기
candidates.concept_granularity: single set of ways to get a new object holding the same values rather than another name for the old one - slicing the whole thing, the copy module, or the method on the list - with identity comparison the way to check which of the two happened

candidates.title: 파이썬 조건문
candidates.concept_granularity: single branching form whose block is marked by a colon and the indentation that follows rather than by braces, which makes the indentation part of the syntax and its style - tab or spaces - a question the community has an answer to

candidates.title: == 와 is
candidates.concept_granularity: single distinction between asking whether two things hold the same value and asking whether they are the same object - which come apart exactly when two separate objects were built from the same contents

candidates.title: 조건부 표현식
candidates.concept_granularity: single one-line form of a branch, written with the value first and the condition in the middle rather than in the question-mark form other languages use - readable enough as english, but not worth nesting, since a second condition is clearer as a full statement

candidates.title: in과 not in
candidates.concept_granularity: single operator asking whether a value occurs inside a string, list or tuple, which is a condition in its own right - and the placeholder statement for a branch that is to do nothing

candidates.title: 파이썬 for문
candidates.concept_granularity: single loop that walks whatever can be iterated - a list, a tuple, a string or a range - rather than counting an index, with the statement that skips the rest of the body and goes on to the next round

candidates.title: range()
candidates.concept_granularity: single object standing for a run of numbers from the first argument up to but not including the second, one argument meaning from zero - which is what a loop counts over when there is nothing to walk

candidates.title: 리스트 내포
candidates.concept_granularity: single form writing a loop inside the brackets that build a list - an expression, the loop over something iterable, and optionally a condition filtering it - which replaces declaring an empty list and appending to it in a loop
